about: The few poses where config/house/layouts/ed-current.json differs from Ed's export of 2026-11-12 (docs/evidence/treehouse-layout-ed-2026-11-12.v2.json), and why (Ed, 2026-11-13: "fix the others"). Each use point travels with its object, as the editor has it. src/editor/currentEdLayout.test.ts checks the export with these applied is the published layout.

fixes.why: Turned 180° where it stands: it faced the wall, its use point 0.32 m off the floor. Now she stands on the floor east of it, 1.95 m inside the edge.

Moved 0.8 m south, not turned: its use point was 0.13 m inside the floor's edge (a step further back was off it) and its footprint 0.6 m past the edge. Now the use point is 0.88 m inside and the whole bench is on the floor.
Turned 180° where it stands: she stood north of it, behind it from the camera. Now she stands south of it, in front.
